description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended dasatinib and nilotinib, within their marketing authorisations, as options for treating chronic- or accelerated-phase Philadelphia-chromosome-positive chronic myeloid leukaemia in adults who cannot have imatinib, or whose disease is imatinib-resistant. Dasatinib and nilotinib are recommended within their marketing authorisations and subject to the discounts agreed in the relevant patient access schemes.
